assembly_notes: No fullCI, production or whole-chain PQ qualification can be granted by this helper.
All original FAIL receipts remain; incomplete contexts are not terminal results.
The final README must be authored by root after terminal receipts are available and passed via --readme.
Exact raw file bytes and archive bytes are preserved; no logs, source files or old fixtures are normalized.
Recorded binary identities are kept as measurements only; no Cargo target or ELF is copied.
A new evidence-only commit does not retroactively turn source Z tests into tests of the later evidence commit.

Every desktop archive needs its independently reviewed exact sha256 added to this plan before staging. The helper streams each archive and compares every original member, including its manifest, without extracting or executing it.

Original full rust-baseline remains FAIL (DA 713 passed / 2 failed) with its downstream oracle/release scope unexecuted. The original Node preflight plus incomplete all-targets record and absent source-after remain separate from the DATA four-terminal-record bundle (3 PASS / 1 FAIL). The DATA parent Node lib reports 1359 passed / 4 failed / 39 ignored, with later targets unexecuted. No attempt replaces or clears another failure.
The original Node all-targets zero-byte result is preserved only by an exact host/source/id/input/origin/four-file-hash archival exception. It is not a terminal PASS or FAIL.

Only that original zero-byte result is projected to result.json.empty in the expanded staging tree; its raw source and frozen tar retain result.json and exact bytes. Record index carries the explicit logical-to-staged mapping.
Missing original node-retained-source-after is preserved as a missing/unproven execution observation, not a fabricated command receipt. Separate /data retry has four required real terminal records.
The prior target directory disappearance has unknown cause. No cleanup success or current ELF presence is claimed from that observation.

The current inventory pins 63 original terminal records (50 PASS / 13 FAIL) and one separate exact incomplete observation. Read-only diagnostics, transport errors, cache cleanup and historical GitHub reads are support, not additional validation records. The owner-written final README is passed via --readme.

incomplete_record_archive_exceptions.reason: Original supervisor outcome is unknown; original result file exists at exactly zero bytes. Preserve raw evidence without synthesizing or repairing a result. Only the staged filename differs; original tar member and input bytes stay unchanged.

Runtime supervisor outcome unknown; source-after directory absent is an observation, not an invented execution receipt. Exact single-record archival exception only.

Received original independent DATA queue: 20 original files plus manifest; 3 PASS and all-targets FAIL rc101. Only Node lib actually executed: parent 1359 passed, 4 failed, 39 ignored, 0 filtered; three nested child summaries are not added. Final source-after is PASS on exact clean Z. Original full-Rust FAIL and original incomplete Node attempt remain separate.

large_file_policy: List exact path, bytes and SHA-256 first; a later reviewed plan may approve the exact triple. ELF payloads and Cargo target trees remain forbidden.
